preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n+1 lines: the first line with n and m, followed by n lines of strings.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == m for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Every book title string has exactly length m.
All book title strings are pairwise distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(all('A' <= c <= 'Z' for c in s) for s in strings)
preconditions.description: All characters in the strings are uppercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.
The output indices form a permutation of 1 to n.
The strings corresponding to the output indices are sorted in non-decreasing order according to the asc-desc-ending comparison rule.
